family: Actual two-clause positive edge DNF with overlapping edges 01 and02; conditioned root law only, not a Fourier spectrum
domain: All positive packing weights (i/16,j/16), i+j<=16; all positive three-cell probability vectors of denominator18; one asymmetric falsifier and rational PSD cut t=1/2
arithmetic: Fraction; exact reconstruction of lambda and root probabilities, determinant and separating quadratic form
inference_limit: The two-gate cone is exact; in larger tables it is a necessary constraint, not a sufficient global characterization.
